hosts._reasoning: Primary production host with rankingcoach.com and www.rankingcoach.com; contains 130+ FQDNs including critical infrastructure (API, dev, admin, CMS test, Atlassian, BigData, Cassandra, CDN distribution nodes); nginx on 80/443; web_probe shows no HTTP content but Shodan confirms ports open — likely behind WAF or requires specific headers; must scan for security posture.
IPv6 load balancer (ip6-lb2-eu) hosting rankingcoach.com, www.rankingcoach.com and 30+ CDN distribution nodes; nginx on 80/443; secondary to primary but critical for availability and CDN security.

CMS testing infrastructure (cms.rankingcoach.com) with 27 VHosts including WordPress, Joomla, Shopware, Magento, Contao, Prestashop, TYPO3, Concrete5; nginx 1.17.6 (outdated, EOL since 2019); phpmyadmin exposed; critical security risk.
Kubernetes cluster infrastructure (k8s.rankingcoach.com, dashboard.k8s, swagger.k8s); internal management interfaces with high attack surface; must assess security controls.
Google Cloud infrastructure (agent0-node-01) with 3 vhost entries; internal agent/node infrastructure; assess for exposure and misconfiguration.
Load balancer (lb2-eu) and CDN nameserver (ns1cdn); nginx on 80/443 and DNS on 53; critical infrastructure for availability and DNS security.
Jimdo integration host with FTP (Pure-FTPd) and SSH (OpenSSH 9.6p1) exposed; file transfer and remote access services present security risk; assess for unauthorized access.
Backup DNS/CDN nameserver (ns3cdn, rc-backup-02); nginx on 80/443 and DNS on 53; critical for DNS resilience and backup infrastructure security.
API staging server (api-staging-server.rankingcoach.com); staging infrastructure with potential exposure of development/test credentials and API endpoints.
Production API node (api01.rankingcoach.com); critical API infrastructure serving customer requests; assess for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
Internship/QA infrastructure (internship.rankingcoach.com, qa01 RDNS); testing environment with potential for exposure of sensitive data or development tools.
Backup infrastructure (backup.rankingcoach.com); backup systems often overlooked in security; assess for proper access controls and encryption.
